acceptance: Define the observability-owned correlation contract for task-derived session labels, local Pi session UUIDs, provider/model evidence, job IDs, and trace references without conflating ownership.

Represent provider request identity as explicitly unavailable unless a named adapter exposes it; retries retain the task-derived label while creating new local sessions; fork lineage remains out of scope.
Add provider-free fixtures for retry, absent, malformed, and unavailable provider metadata, exact trace-to-session correlation, source-labelled provider/model evidence, and privacy exclusions.
Do not change task authority, launch behavior, provider requests, session content handling, or external export beyond the bounded contract and tests.
